evidence.claim: Between 2018 and 2022, multidimensional poverty in Mexico fell from 41.9 percent to 36.3 percent, and the number of people in poverty fell from 51.9 million to 46.8 million.
evidence.title: Comunicado No. 7, El CONEVAL presenta las estimaciones de pobreza multidimensional 2022
evidence.publisher: CONEVAL
evidence.excerpt: Between 2018 and 2022, multidimensional poverty in Mexico fell from 41.9 percent to 36.3 percent, and the number of people in poverty fell from 51.9 million to 46.8 million.
evidence.source_locator: page 0 and page 3 of the PDF, lines 13-19 and 136-147
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary official poverty release with explicit national estimates and a clear target-year fit.
evidence.period_fit: Retrospective on the 2018-2022 period, directly covering the target year.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Partly attributable to AMLO because it captures his full sexenio to 2022, but the report itself also reflects pandemic recovery and remittances.
contrary_evidence: The period starts in 2018, so part of the change predates some 2022 policy choices.
The report does not itself isolate the contribution of one president versus external conditions.

evidence.claim: AMLO’s plan to increase state control of electricity generation was defeated in Congress, with opponents warning it would hurt investment and breach international obligations.
evidence.title: Mexican president's contentious electricity overhaul defeated in Congress
evidence.publisher: Reuters / Investing.com
evidence.excerpt: AMLO’s plan to increase state control of electricity generation was defeated in Congress, with opponents warning it would hurt investment and breach international obligations.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting on a concrete legislative defeat with direct policy implications for investment and competition.
evidence.period_fit: Direct 2022 policy conflict in the target year.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable because it was AMLO’s plan and his governing coalition pushed it.
contrary_evidence: AMLO framed the overhaul as protecting public interest and energy sovereignty.
Congress defeated the constitutional version, so the final policy outcome was partly blocked rather than fully enacted.

evidence.claim: In the first bimestre of 2022, the government dispersed pension and welfare payments to 10.4 million rightsholders, including 9.2 million adult pension beneficiaries and 927,742 disability pension beneficiaries.
evidence.title: Realiza Secretaría de Bienestar pagos de pensiones y apoyos del primer bimestre del año a 10.4 millones de derechohabientes
evidence.publisher: Secretaría de Bienestar / Gobierno de México
evidence.excerpt: In the first bimestre of 2022, the government dispersed pension and welfare payments to 10.4 million rightsholders, including 9.2 million adult pension beneficiaries and 927,742 disability pension beneficiaries.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary government release with specific beneficiary counts and payment amounts.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct federal program delivery under AMLO; the release reflects executive policy but not independent auditing of results.
contrary_evidence: The figures measure coverage and disbursement, not program adequacy or impact.

evidence.claim: The government said 12.1 million beneficiaries received September-October 2022 pension and welfare payments and that these transfers were made directly, without intermediaries.
evidence.title: Secretaría de Bienestar dispersa 46.7 mil mdp a 12.1 millones de derechohabientes de pensiones y programas
evidence.publisher: Secretaría de Bienestar / Gobierno de México
evidence.excerpt: The government said 12.1 million beneficiaries received September-October 2022 pension and welfare payments and that these transfers were made directly, without intermediaries.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary administrative release with concrete beneficiary and disbursement totals.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to AMLO-era federal welfare administration, though direct delivery is executed by agencies and Banco del Bienestar.
contrary_evidence: Direct delivery does not by itself exclude local-level patronage or uneven take-up.

evidence.claim: By December 2022, the disability pension served 1,301,922 people with 22 billion pesos in social investment, and the government described the program as being universal in 14 entities.
evidence.title: 1.3 millones de personas ya reciben Pensión para el Bienestar de las Personas con Discapacidad, con inversión de 22 mil mdp
evidence.publisher: Secretaría de Bienestar / Gobierno de México
evidence.excerpt: By December 2022, the disability pension served 1,301,922 people with 22 billion pesos in social investment, and the government described the program as being universal in 14 entities.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary government release with explicit beneficiary and funding figures.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to the AMLO administration and intergovernmental agreements, though universalization was shared with state governments.
contrary_evidence: Universalization was incomplete nationwide, so this was expansion rather than full national coverage.

evidence.claim: In the first half of 2022, Mexico delivered more than 44 billion pesos in Benito Juárez scholarships to over 10 million students, with priority placement in indigenous and very high-margin schools to reduce dropout.
evidence.title: Entrega SEP más de 44 mil millones de pesos en becas Benito Juárez durante el primer semestre de 2022: CNBBBJ
evidence.publisher: Coordinación Nacional de Becas para el Bienestar Benito Juárez / Gobierno de México
evidence.excerpt: In the first half of 2022, Mexico delivered more than 44 billion pesos in Benito Juárez scholarships to over 10 million students, with priority placement in indigenous and very high-margin schools to reduce dropout.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary education-program release with concrete funding, beneficiary, and targeting figures.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to the federal executive and education bureaucracy; local school conditions still mediate delivery.
contrary_evidence: Coverage figures do not by themselves establish learning quality or completion outcomes.

evidence.claim: By March 2022, Producción para el Bienestar had transferred 12.5 billion pesos to support 1,766,430 small- and medium-scale producers through direct payments intended to provide liquidity for inputs and labor and strengthen food supply for families and communities.
evidence.title: Entrega Producción para el Bienestar apoyos directos para más de 1.7 millones de productores de pequeña y mediana escala
evidence.publisher: Secretaría de Agricultura y Desarrollo Rural / Gobierno de México
evidence.excerpt: By March 2022, Producción para el Bienestar had transferred 12.5 billion pesos to support 1,766,430 small- and medium-scale producers through direct payments intended to provide liquidity for inputs and labor and strengthen food supply for families and communities.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary agriculture ministry release with precise beneficiary and transfer figures.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct federal agricultural policy under AMLO; it supports rural producers, though broader market conditions also affect farm incomes.
contrary_evidence: The release is self-reported and does not independently verify end-user welfare effects.

evidence.claim: The 2022 minimum wage increase was 22 percent, the largest in 34 years, and the government said it directly benefited 6 million workers while recovering 71 percent of the minimum wage's purchasing power.
evidence.title: Entra en vigor incremento al salario mínimo del 22%
evidence.publisher: Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social / Gobierno de México
evidence.excerpt: The 2022 minimum wage increase was 22 percent, the largest in 34 years, and the government said it directly benefited 6 million workers while recovering 71 percent of the minimum wage's purchasing power.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary labor-policy announcement with specific wage and beneficiary figures.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to the AMLO administration through the federal wage-setting process, though the tripartite wage commission shares formal authority.
contrary_evidence: The statement is policy intent and summary, not an independent estimate of full distributional effects.

evidence.claim: The OECD said Mexico's poverty and regional inequalities remain high, medium-term growth has weakened, weak investment and low female participation persist, and social spending and public investment have increased while health and education systems remain strained and infrastructure gaps remain significant.
evidence.title: OECD Economic Surveys: Mexico 2022
evidence.publisher: OECD
evidence.excerpt: The OECD said Mexico's poverty and regional inequalities remain high, medium-term growth has weakened, weak investment and low female participation persist, and social spending and public investment have increased while health and education systems remain strained and infrastructure gaps remain significant.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent multilateral survey with explicit 2022 assessment and detailed policy diagnostics.
evidence.period_fit: Directly about the target year environment.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Only partly attributable to AMLO because the report also emphasizes pandemic, structural, and long-run constraints.
contrary_evidence: The same survey says Mexico has a solid macroeconomic framework, so the picture is mixed rather than uniformly negative.

evidence.claim: CONEVAL's 2022 development-social-policy evaluation covers 2018-2022, diagnoses distributive-incidence and course-of-life gaps, and says there are growing inequalities affecting groups such as the indigenous population and a lack of integrated vision in parts of the social-policy portfolio.
evidence.title: Informe de Evaluación de la Política de Desarrollo Social 2022
evidence.publisher: CONEVAL
evidence.excerpt: CONEVAL's 2022 development-social-policy evaluation covers 2018-2022, diagnoses distributive-incidence and course-of-life gaps, and says there are growing inequalities affecting groups such as the indigenous population and a lack of integrated vision in parts of the social-policy portfolio.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Domestic evaluation body with a formal statutory mandate and explicit 2018-2022 coverage.
evidence.period_fit: Retrospective but explicitly centered on the target period.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect but material: it evaluates the federal social-policy environment under AMLO rather than a single program.
contrary_evidence: The same report also notes advances in the incorporation of rights and course-of-life approaches.

evidence.claim: AMLO framed the 2022 program as having restored the pre-COVID economy while advancing social programs, pensions, the Tren Maya, aduanas modernization, and other infrastructure, and he claimed these results showed the transformation project was working.
evidence.title: Discurso del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador en el Cuarto Informe de Gobierno
evidence.publisher: Presidencia de la República 2018-2024 / Gobierno de México
evidence.excerpt: AMLO framed the 2022 program as having restored the pre-COVID economy while advancing social programs, pensions, the Tren Maya, aduanas modernization, and other infrastructure, and he claimed these results showed the transformation project was working.
evidence.source_locator: opening paragraphs and the passages on employment, income, Tren Maya, aduanas, and infrastructure
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary annual-report speech from the ruler; strong for declared program and claimed progress, weaker for independent proof of success.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO; it is his own account of priorities and progress, not independent verification.
contrary_evidence: Independent sources still flagged weak investment, high inequality, and incomplete implementation in 2022.

evidence.claim: AMLO said austerity meant cutting nonessential spending, travel, and operating costs without firing workers so savings could be redirected to the people and strategic development projects.
evidence.title: Austeridad es un asunto de principios, afirma presidente; Gobierno de México fomenta ahorros en beneficio de la gente
evidence.publisher: Presidencia de la República 2018-2024 / Gobierno de México
evidence.excerpt: AMLO said austerity meant cutting nonessential spending, travel, and operating costs without firing workers so savings could be redirected to the people and strategic development projects.
evidence.source_locator: conference transcript quoted in the article
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Strong evidence for what he said and how he framed the method; weaker as proof that the method improved effectiveness.
evidence.period_fit: Directly within 2022 and tied to the year's operating method.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to AMLO's own stated approach; it supports program translation but not success by itself.
contrary_evidence: Austerity claims do not by themselves show better execution, lower waste, or improved outcomes.

evidence.claim: The decree created IMSS-BIENESTAR to extend free and progressively expanded health services to people without social security.
evidence.title: DECRETO por el que se crea el organismo público descentralizado denominado Servicios de Salud del Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social para el Bienestar (IMSS-BIENESTAR)
evidence.publisher: Diario Oficial de la Federación / Presidencia de la República
evidence.excerpt: The decree created IMSS-BIENESTAR to extend free and progressively expanded health services to people without social security.
evidence.source_locator: decree text and the constitutional-health justification in the opening recital
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Formal legal act in the target year; very strong for the existence and stated purpose of the institution.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct executive action under AMLO; it shows ownership of the institutional change, though service quality and coverage gains require separate evidence.
contrary_evidence: The decree alone does not prove effective rollout, quality, or durable coverage expansion in 2022.

evidence.claim: Reuters reported that AMLO's plan to increase state control of power generation was defeated in parliament after opposition parties said it would hurt investment and breach international obligations.
evidence.title: Mexican president's contentious electricity overhaul defeated in Congress
evidence.publisher: Reuters
evidence.excerpt: Reuters reported that AMLO's plan to increase state control of power generation was defeated in parliament after opposition parties said it would hurt investment and breach international obligations.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting on a concrete legislative outcome is strong evidence for the failure of this flagship initiative.
evidence.period_fit: Directly within 2022 and central to the administration's energy program.
evidence.ruler_attribution: High attribution: this was AMLO's own flagship reform, though passage depended on Congress and outside constraints.
contrary_evidence: Defeat reflects legislative limits as well as potential weaknesses in coalition management and persuasion.

evidence.claim: Reuters reported that Mexico spent about 575 billion pesos on anti-inflation subsidies in 2022, mostly gasoline and energy support, and officials said inflation would have been 2.6 percentage points higher without them.
evidence.title: Mexico anti-inflation subsidies come with $28 billion price tag
evidence.publisher: Reuters
evidence.excerpt: Reuters reported that Mexico spent about 575 billion pesos on anti-inflation subsidies in 2022, mostly gasoline and energy support, and officials said inflation would have been 2.6 percentage points higher without them.
evidence.source_locator: Reuters report on the subsidy package and official estimate of the inflation effect
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Strong for the spending scale and official explanation; the effect estimate is official and should be treated cautiously.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Partly attributable to AMLO's administration because the measures were deliberate policy, but the underlying inflation shock was externally driven and Banxico was independent on interest rates.
contrary_evidence: The package was expensive and relied heavily on untargeted fuel support, which reduces policy efficiency.

evidence.claim: The IMF said Mexico's recovery was gradual, inflation became entrenched, the government kept a broadly neutral fiscal stance in 2022, and largely untargeted subsidies helped support real incomes.
evidence.title: El Directorio Ejecutivo del FMI concluye la Consulta del Artículo IV con México correspondiente a 2022
evidence.publisher: Fondo Monetario Internacional
evidence.excerpt: The IMF said Mexico's recovery was gradual, inflation became entrenched, the government kept a broadly neutral fiscal stance in 2022, and largely untargeted subsidies helped support real incomes.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Authoritative external assessment with direct 2022 macro-policy analysis; attribution remains partial because shocks and central-bank actions also matter.
evidence.period_fit: Directly within 2022 and about the target-year macro response.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Partial: the fiscal stance and subsidy package are attributable to the administration, but inflation, growth, and Banxico policy were shaped by external shocks and an independent central bank.
contrary_evidence: The same IMF assessment highlights entrenched inflation, weaker growth prospects, and persistent structural problems.

evidence.claim: Ramírez de la O appeared before the Senate under oath to report on the 2022 fiscal package and macroeconomic policy, showing a real delegated implementation channel for AMLO's program.
evidence.title: Intervención inicial del secretario de Hacienda y Crédito Público, Rogelio Ramírez de la O, durante su comparecencia en Sesión Ordinaria del Senado, como parte de la Glosa del Cuarto Informe de Gobierno
evidence.publisher: Coordinación de Comunicación Social del Senado de la República
evidence.excerpt: Ramírez de la O appeared before the Senate under oath to report on the 2022 fiscal package and macroeconomic policy, showing a real delegated implementation channel for AMLO's program.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary legislative transcript for a named cabinet official and the target-year budget process; strong for delegation and oversight, not for performance quality.
evidence.ruler_attribution: High attribution: Ramírez de la O was AMLO's finance secretary and the central fiscal operator, though outcomes still reflect external shocks and congressional constraints.
contrary_evidence: This confirms process and authority, not successful execution by itself.

evidence.claim: Juan Pablo de Botton was ratified as subsecretary of Egresos, with an explicit mandate to make spending effective, efficient, transparent, and fiscally responsible.
evidence.title: Comunicado No. 9 Juan Pablo de Botton fue ratificado por la Cámara de Diputados como subsecretario de Egresos
evidence.publisher: Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público
evidence.excerpt: Juan Pablo de Botton was ratified as subsecretary of Egresos, with an explicit mandate to make spending effective, efficient, transparent, and fiscally responsible.
evidence.source_locator: first paragraphs and the mandate description
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official appointment notice with clear role description and policy mandate; strong for personnel selection, not for downstream results.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to the AMLO administration's staffing choices, though one appointment does not prove broad competence.
contrary_evidence: This is appointment evidence, not proof of the quality of execution across the whole administration.

evidence.claim: Federal and Colima authorities signed a transition table to implement and operate IMSS-Bienestar, with diagnostics for staffing, infrastructure, and medicine supply, and Zoé Robledo said it was advancing on AMLO's instruction.
evidence.title: Autoridades federales y de Colima inician transición del sistema de salud estatal a IMSS-Bienestar
evidence.publisher: Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social
evidence.excerpt: Federal and Colima authorities signed a transition table to implement and operate IMSS-Bienestar, with diagnostics for staffing, infrastructure, and medicine supply, and Zoé Robledo said it was advancing on AMLO's instruction.
evidence.source_locator: opening paragraphs and the diagnostics section
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary implementation notice with concrete state transition steps and operational details; strong evidence of execution, though still partial and state-specific.
evidence.ruler_attribution: High attribution for policy direction; implementation was carried by health officials and a state governor, so this is delegation-plus-execution evidence rather than personal micromanagement.
contrary_evidence: This shows implementation in one state and a transition process, not complete national rollout or service-quality proof.

evidence.claim: The federal government issued a mandatory strategic health program that defined the objectives, strategies, and actions for federalizing and progressively extending free health services to people without social security.
evidence.title: ACUERDO por el que se emite el Programa Estratégico de Salud para el Bienestar
evidence.publisher: Diario Oficial de la Federación / Secretaría de Salud
evidence.excerpt: The federal government issued a mandatory strategic health program that defined the objectives, strategies, and actions for federalizing and progressively extending free health services to people without social security.
evidence.source_locator: article one and the explanatory recitals
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Formal legal act in the target year; very strong evidence for operationalization and institutionalization, weaker for realized service quality.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to the AMLO government, although the decree itself is not proof of successful delivery on the ground.
contrary_evidence: A decree does not itself show nationwide implementation quality or durability.

unresolved_gaps: Federal command attribution is still thin for several state-level protest, journalist, and policing incidents.
Independent evidence that AMLO strengthened courts, the INE, INAI, or other checks is still weak compared with the evidence of media hostility and electoral-pressure attempts.
Direct personal-nexus evidence on self-enrichment, hidden ownership, or preferential benefit remains thin, and several items are still allegations or self-reports.
Independent audit-level evidence on on-time, on-budget delivery and the causal split between AMLO policy and external tailwinds is still incomplete.

run_provenance.source_mix_note: Rich source metadata and chapter-specific reviewer exclusions were preserved during deterministic conversion.
